reference.title: Archived profile behavior
reference.shortdesc: Archived profiles stay visible through lifecycle filters but have limitations compared with active profiles.

section.title: Purpose
section.p: Archive keeps a profile for review or later restore without keeping it in the normal active working set.

section.title: Limitations
section.p: Archived rows are not normal active export targets, and some row actions are disabled until the profile is restored.

section.title: Warning
section.p: Permanent delete can still remove an archived profile. Confirm the row carefully before destructive actions.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: Restore an archived profile when you need normal editing or active lifecycle behavior again.
